phase: V2 JOINTMINUTESV2: joint team minutes anchored on Phase 1B + unmodeled-rotation reservoir + role-tier factor + reliability-weighted bounded reconciliation
pre_freeze_disclosure: 2024-25 is DEVELOPMENT data: it was evaluated in Phase 3 (selection + rebuild) and in the read-only S2 audit, whose findings (incomplete early-season candidate universe, budget infeasibility, the old activation repair, role-tier minutes correlations of 2024-25 OOS residuals, rotation under-dispersion of the logit-normal) motivated this design. Before this freeze the implementation was debugged only mechanically on 2023-24 inputs with a synthetic P(play) (no predictive metric of any arm was inspected) and on unit tests. Reservoir, reliability weights and tier factor are FITTED on training seasons only (labels <= 2023-24). 2025-26 was not read.
current_champion: S0 = Phase 1B marginals + Phase 2 J2 (phase2_selection_fit_2023_24.json for this chronology)

arms.S0: JM0 = champion: Phase 1B marginals + Phase 2 J2
arms.JM1: diagnostic: random Phase 1B conditional minutes (independent, no tier factor, no reconciliation, no reservoir) through the JM2 GLM / refit dispersion / residual J2, alpha = 1.0
arms.JM2_A05: JointMinutesV2, structural means anchored alpha = 0.5 toward Phase 1B
arms.alpha_rule: alpha* = argmin aggregate MARG_LOG over JM2_A05 / JM2_A10 (tie -> 1.0); gates apply to alpha*

development.runs: exactly once (a genuine, result-independent implementation bug is the only reason for a documented rerun)

chronology.confirmation_2025_26: NOT in this protocol: one locked retrospective confirmation, only after architect approval, parameters through 2024-25

candidate_universe.definition: ex.player_game_examples = feat.player_features = Phase 1B candidate rows: every player with legal pregame evidence (prior appearance, prior-season returner / roster, preseason transfer / recruit)
candidate_universe.completion_check: ex.team_membership_evidence available_from <= cutoff adds 0 players; ex.roster_snapshot_research is SEASON_ROSTER_ONLY_NOT_PIT_CONFIRMED (not used); every lab.player_pool_misses row has legal_evidence = false
never_used_for_membership: target-game participants / box rows / minutes / DNP status

reservoir.what: aggregate stochastic unmodeled-rotation minutes R per team-game draw: absorbs team minutes of players outside the candidate universe; never priced, never a player, no stats, no combos
reservoir.feature_source: feat.player_features aggregated per team-game (n candidates, cold-start class shares, team games so far = max pp_team_games, returning-minutes share)
reservoir.model: P(R > 0) logistic; E[R | R > 0] log-linear (Poisson pseudo-likelihood); positive part Gamma with pooled CV (moments); fitted on team-games 2013-14..T; label = realized minutes of players outside the universe (lab.player_pool_misses, TRAINING label only)
reservoir.draw: R_raw = 1[u < pi] mu_pos Gamma(1/cv2, cv2), capped at 5 D

minutes.participation: independent Bernoulli(Phase 1B P(play)) per candidate; NO activation repair; fewer than five known players active is absorbed by the reservoir
minutes.raw: z_i = f_(team, tier(i)) + sqrt(1 - Cf_tt) eps_i; raw_i = clip(min_mu + min_sigma z_i, 0, 60) x D / E[D] (the Phase 1B discretized-normal conditional marginal sampled directly; no role-specific scale correction)
minutes.tier_factor: 3 tiers (TOP5_MINUTES, ROTATION_6_8, BENCH_9PLUS; NO_ROLE_HISTORY -> bench); target = pooled OOS normal-score correlations of PLAYED teammates in regulation games, Phase 1B OOS 2022-23..T, shrunk with 2000 pseudo-pairs; latent Cf = PSD projection, diagonal in [0, 0.95]; 3 constraint-compensation fixed-point steps on 400 training team-games of season T (realized participants, 2000 draws); independent across the two teams; no named-player or pair parameters
minutes.reconciliation: m* = argmin (m - raw)' W^-1 (m - raw) + (R - R_raw)^2 / w_R s.t. sum m + R = 5 D, 0 <= m_i <= D, m_i = 0 nonparticipants, R >= 0; exact (bisection + linear solve on the active set; closure <= 1e-09 absorbed by R, else the freest player)
minutes.W: diagonal: pooled OOS Var(y_min - min_mu) of PLAYED rows by role x {WARM, COLD}, shrunk to the global variance with 500 pseudo-rows; Phase 1B OOS 2022-23..T
minutes.duration: one draw per game shared by both teams from the Phase 3 overtime law (D = 40 + 5K); pace never changes the clock
minutes.scored_player_world: single-player quantities in the player's forced-active world (same draw, same uniforms / normals, re-solved with him active)

stat_means.exposure: log(max(M, 1) / min_mu) with ONE reconciled M per player per draw for all 7 stats
stat_means.glm: Poisson pseudo-likelihood with offset log mu_1B on Phase 1B OOS rows 2022-23..T given the realized state (phase3.fit_structure with these terms)

dispersion_refit: one phi per stat by method of moments on the true-OOS structural residual basis given realized minutes + environment (families kept); never Phase 1B phi + minutes variance
residual_dependence: J2 architecture (dependence.fit, MID) refit on the conditional PMFs of the true-OOS structural residual basis (season F with parameters through F-1)

joint: PRA / PR / PA / RA / STOCKS log / CRPS / Brier
diagnostics_not_gates: PTS latent spread ratio by role

development_gates_vs_S0.rule: strict: a gate passes only if the 95% bootstrap interval bound clears its margin; inconclusive = fail
development_gates_vs_S0.G1: MIN_CRPS(JM2) - MIN_CRPS(S0) upper bound <= +0.01 (all scored player-games)
development_gates_vs_S0.G2: same for TOP5_MINUTES, ROTATION_6_8, BENCH_9PLUS: upper bound <= +0.02
development_gates_vs_S0.G3: EARLY_SEASON and MONTH:NOV upper bound <= +0.02; RESERVOIR_HEAVY upper bound <= +0.05
development_gates_vs_S0.G5: every stat MARG_LOG upper bound <= +0.002 and every stat x tier upper bound <= +0.005
development_gates_vs_S0.G6: ES upper bound <= +0.003 and VS_BAL upper bound <= +0.0001; each bound at least 3 MC SE from its margin (else inconclusive)
development_gates_vs_S0.G7: BOTH_TOP_SCORERS_OVER (TM_SCORER_SCORER): Brier below S0 and |observed - mean predicted| smaller (the Phase 3 A6 rule, unchanged)
development_gates_vs_S0.G8: 0 accounting violations (team minutes incl. reservoir = 5 D within 1e-09, bounds, inactive = 0, reservoir >= 0), 0 combo identity violations, 0 invalid matrices
development_gates_vs_S0.G9: 0 point-in-time violations of the reservoir features; universe is the legal pregame universe
development_gates_vs_S0.G10: 0 genuine PIT violations of the team environment features
development_gates_vs_S0.decision: ADVANCE_TO_CONFIRMATION iff every gate passes for alpha*; otherwise REJECT. A design failure is not tuned and rerun.

seeds.structural_streams: BLAKE2b(20271|stream|game): duration, environment, participation, minutes, tier_factor, reservoir

candidate_universe_audit_training_and_de.universe: ex.player_game_examples (= feat.player_features rows = Phase 1B candidate rows)
candidate_universe_audit_training_and_de.conclusion: the universe already holds every player with legal pregame evidence; the remaining realized minutes outside it (no legal pregame evidence) are carried by the reservoir
